examples.en: Philip went into his room and shut the door behind him.
examples.zh: 菲利普进了自己的房间，随手把门关上。

examples.en: Philip paced the floor, a typically nervous expectant father.
examples.zh: 菲利普在地板上踱来踱去，一个典型紧张的准爸爸。

examples.en: Philip pledges support and offers to help in any way that he can.
examples.zh: 菲利普承诺给予支持并提供力所能及的帮助。
